Create a candlestick chart

Source: R/candlestick_chart.R
candlestick_chart.Rd

Draws the open, high, low and close prices of each period as a candle: the body spans the open and the close (green when the price went up, red when it went down) and the wick spans the low and the high. Volumes can be shown as bars below the prices, and moving averages of the close as lines. The periods are drawn side by side, so days without trading leave no gap.

Usage

candlestick_chart(
  data,
  date,
  open,
  high,
  low,
  close,
  volume = NULL,
  moving_average = NULL,
  up_col = "#2e9d5b",
  down_col = "#e5484d",
  ma_colors = NULL,
  value_format = ",.2f",
  date_format = NULL,
  y_title = NULL,
  zoom = TRUE,
  hover = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  title_font_size = 16,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bg_col = "white",
  text_col = "#333333",
  grid_col = "#ececec",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per period.

date

The name of the column with the dates (Date, POSIXct or text).

open, high, low, close

The names of the numeric columns with the prices.

volume

Optional. The name of a numeric column with the volumes.

moving_average

Optional. One or more window lengths (in periods) for moving averages of the close, such as c(20, 50).

up_col, down_col

The colours of the rising and the falling candles. Default to "#2e9d5b" and "#e5484d".

ma_colors

Optional. The colours of the moving averages.

value_format

A d3 format for the prices. Defaults to ",.2f".

date_format

Optional. A d3 time format for the dates, such as "%d/%m/%Y". Defaults to "%b %-d, %Y" (with the time when the dates have one).

y_title

Optional. The title of the price axis.

zoom

Logical. Let the viewer zoom and pan in time. Defaults to TRUE.

hover

Logical. Show the crosshair and the prices. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Let the candles appear when the chart is drawn. Defaults to TRUE.

title

Optional. The title of the chart.

title_font_size

The font size of the title. Defaults to 16.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

text_col

The colour of the text and the axes. Defaults to "#333333".

grid_col

The colour of the grid lines; NULL for none. Defaults to "#ececec".

width, height

Optional. The size of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

Move the mouse over the chart: a crosshair follows it and the prices of the period are written at the top. Scroll to zoom in time and drag to pan (zoom); the price axis fits the visible candles, and a double-click resets the view. The candles appear from left to right when the chart is drawn. Inside Shiny, clicking a candle sets input$<id>_clicked to a list with date, open, high, low, close and volume.

Examples

# A simulated stock over 120 trading days
set.seed(42)
days <- seq(as.Date("2025-01-01"), by = "day", length.out = 170)
days <- days[!format(days, "%u") %in% c("6", "7")][1:120]
close <- 100 * cumprod(1 + rnorm(120, 0.001, 0.018))
open <- c(100, head(close, -1)) * (1 + rnorm(120, 0, 0.004))
stock <- data.frame(
  day = days,
  open = open,
  high = pmax(open, close) * (1 + abs(rnorm(120, 0, 0.008))),
  low = pmin(open, close) * (1 - abs(rnorm(120, 0, 0.008))),
  close = close,
  volume = round(rlnorm(120, 13, 0.4))
)
candlestick_chart(stock, date = "day", open = "open", high = "high",
                  low = "low", close = "close", volume = "volume",
                  moving_average = c(10, 30), value_format = "$,.2f",
                  title = "A simulated stock")



candlestick_chart(tail(stock, 40), date = "day", open = "open", high = "high",
                  low = "low", close = "close",
                  up_col = "#4269d0", down_col = "#ff725c")
